name: Durham
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Durham for 2026, and here is what he found: 27 family events, 14 of them free. The new listings run from November 26 (Pictures with Santa at The Streets at Southpoint) to December 24, with Cirque du Soleil's 'Twas the Night Before at DPAC (through December 6), Christmas by Candlelight at Duke Homestead (December 4 and 11), Santa on the Roof at The Durham Hotel (December 12) and A Christmas Carol at DPAC (December 16 to 20) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Durham

  • 27 Christmas events for kids in Durham
  • 14 free events, including Santa Paws at Durham Armory, Santa on the Roof at The Durham Hotel, FAM JAMS at Hub RTP and Holiday at the Lodge at Spruce Pine Lodge
  • Meet Santa: Santa on the Roof, Santa Storytime and Cookie Decorating at For Garden's Sake, Santa Paws and Pictures with Santa at The Streets at Southpoint
  • Stage shows: 'Twas the Night Before by Cirque du Soleil and A Christmas Carol at DPAC
  • Lights and history: Christmas by Candlelight at Duke Homestead (December 4 and 11)
  • Season: November 26 to December 24, 2026 for the newest listings

Planning a bigger day out? Durham families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Raleigh, which covers the NC Chinese Lantern Festival, Sensory Friendly Winter Fest and the New Hope Valley Railway Santa Express.
